names.name: Chronicoms
names.quote: I was sent here 30,000 years ago to observe and record the evolution of your species... My Earth name is Enoch. I am a sentient Chronicom from a planet which revolves around a star in the constellation you know as Cygnus.
names.why: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5E5 'Rewind' (series episode 93). Enoch says he is a Chronicom sent here as an observer, so he serves them. S6E12/13 also say 'the Chronicoms', 'our fellow anthropologists'. Key the stage to 'Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5'. This is a different group from the existing 'The Chronicom Hunters', which Enoch turns against in S6.

names.name: Lighthorsemen
names.quote: (no line found) The 1800s part of the episode has no dialogue. The SDH captions show only sound cues: '(GUN SHOTS) (WAR CRY) (MEN GRUNTING)...'
names.why: Echo ep 3 'Tuklo'. 'Lighthorse' is not in the captions, and the wiki's two stills from the scene show no title card. The episode tells this part like a silent film and may use title cards, which the captions leave out, so I can't rule the name out. Tuklo is only shown saving her father's squad, which makes her an ally under the rules; the claim that she 'joins' comes from the wiki (Wikipedia calls her 'the first female Lighthorseman' in its cast notes). Options: (a) none, which I recommend: no stage, and she keeps Choctaw Nation; (b) 'Lighthorsemen', if the owner remembers a title card that names it and shows her joining.

names.name: Loki Bandits
names.quote: Boastful Loki: 'In exchange for shelter and supplies, you give me your army and I take the throne.' President Loki: 'Ah, yes. Not so good a bargain. How about this one? My army, my throne?'
names.why: Loki S1E5. The episode never says 'Loki Bandits'; the wiki takes that name from The Art of Loki book. On screen the band is only called President Loki's 'army'. This follows the dataset's 'Kid Loki's Crew' pattern. If the owner reads this as a plain description and not a name, make it an owner call.

names.name: Morgan le Fay's Coven
names.quote: Bronwyn: 'Should we take them all? Morgan will be thrilled.' Chase: 'Morgan? I recognize you. You're in the coven.'
names.why: Runaways S3E7. The dataset already has 'Morgan's coven' (Nico, Runaways S3). Morgan le Fay leads it ('Morgan's Dark Army' in S3E9 is her demon army, a different group).

names.name: Cassandra Nova's Henchmen
names.quote: 'The only other helmet that strong is Juggernaut's, but he works for Cassandra.' (Only the SDH sound cues say '[henchmen screaming]'.)
names.why: Deadpool & Wolverine. No line names Cassandra's followers as a group; 'henchmen' appears only in the caption sound cues. The rules give this label as an example of an invented one. The dataset has no name for it. Options: (a) none, which I recommend: no stage, and the steps already say they 'fight for Cassandra Nova'; (b) a descriptive label such as "Cassandra Nova's forces", if the owner wants one. Note: Pyro also works secretly for Paradox (TVA).

names.name: The Sandstormers
names.quote: Candra: 'Pharaoh, the Sandstormers. They approach the city, led by the abomination they call En Sabah Nur.' / 'En Sabah Nur rides with his army of Sandstormers.'
names.why: X-Men '97 S2E3 'Rise of Apocalypse - Part I' (the record's episode 13). En Sabah Nur leads them. In S2E4 he says 'my people killed', which ends the group; the stage should close there.

names.name: Monster Hunting Cabal
names.quote: Ulysses (recording): 'Thank you, Verussa, for seeing it through and for shaping our cause like no other... it is now time to choose a new leader in the crusade against monsters... The hunter who slays this beast will become our new leader.' Narrator: 'Hunters have gathered from around the globe, strangers until this night.'
names.why: Werewolf by Night. The film never says 'cabal'; the word comes from Disney's marketing synopsis. On screen the hunters share a creed and a leader (Ulysses, then the hunt's winner), which makes them a real group, but it is only called 'our cause' or 'the crusade against monsters'. The narrator even calls them 'strangers'. Options: (a) none (no stage); (b) a descriptive label taken from the screen, such as 'Crusade Against Monsters' or 'Bloodstone's hunters'. Whatever is chosen should also apply to 'The Monster Hunting Cabal' (same group, same title).

names.name: Council of Godheads
names.quote: Zeus: 'Order. Order! Silence! I hereby open... this holy council of the god.' Thor: 'Gods of the universe... I come here to ask for your help.'
names.why: Thor: Love and Thunder. The film never says 'Council of Godheads' (a comics name). Zeus opens and runs a 'holy council of the god[s]' in Omnipotence City, so describe it the way the screen does. Owner can choose another wording (e.g. 'Omnipotence City'). The quote is from captions, which write Zeus's accented line as 'of the god'.

names.name: Muspelheim
names.quote: (no line found) Surtur: 'I cannot die. Not until I fulfill my destiny and lay waste to your home... I am Asgard's doom.'
names.why: Thor: Ragnarok. The film never says 'Muspelheim', and no realm, people or army is named for Surtur. Giving him the realm would be inferring a group from a place.

names.name: Kravinoff Criminal Empire
names.quote: Sergei: 'I was to follow in his footsteps and take over the family business.' Nikolai: 'Our empire is secured.' Sergei to Dmitri: 'You didn't want to sell father's business?' / Rhino: 'The name Kravinoff still opens doors.'
names.why: Kraven the Hunter. The criminal operation is real, but on screen it is only 'the family business', 'father's business' or 'our empire'. 'Kravinoff Criminal Empire' is never said. (The captions found look like a re-translation, so exact wording may differ.) Options: (a) a descriptive label such as "Kravinoff's empire" or 'the Kravinoff family business'; (b) none.

names.name: Spider-Catchers
names.quote: (no transcript found) Marvel Database plot for 19A 'To Catch a Spider': 'Dr. Noah Boddy releases Electro, the Green Goblin, and the Vulture from prison to get back at Spider-Man.'
names.why: Spider-Man (1967) ep 19A 'To Catch a Spider'. I could not find a transcript. The name 'Spider-Catchers' traces to the 2017 comic Spider-Verse Team-Up #2: the Earth-67 team page credits that comic's creators, and its alias is just the episode title. No source shows the name said on screen. Options: (a) none, which I recommend: no stage, since the four only team up for one scheme; (b) keep 'Spider-Catchers' only if the owner confirms the episode says it.

names.name: The Workshop
names.quote: Ajax: 'Mr. Wilson, my name's Ajax. I manage this workshop... This workshop is not a government-led program. It's a private institution...' / 'This workshop doesn't make superheroes, we make superslaves.'
names.why: Deadpool (2016). Ajax names and runs it. Angel Dust works there alongside him (record: 'helps Ajax run his lab').

names.name: Ancient Egypt
names.quote: Nightcrawler: 'in an ancient Egypt of murderous robots...' / En Sabah Nur: 'My quest to free Egypt has failed.' / 'Your one true ruler, your pharaoh, Rama-Tut.' / 'Bring me to the seat of Rama-Tut's kingdom.'
names.why: X-Men '97 S2E3/S2E4 (record episodes 13-14). Rama-Tut rules as Egypt's pharaoh, and 'Egypt' and 'ancient Egypt' are both said. He leaves when he abandons Candra and flees in his time machine (S2E4). 'Egypt' alone would also fit if the owner prefers.

names.name: The Tivan Group
names.quote: 'Taneleer Tivan, also known as The Collector? As in the most ruthless kingpin in the intergalactic underworld?' / 'He's got the Black Order doing security.'
names.why: What If...? S1E2. 'Tivan Group' is never said. The Collector is a lone crime boss who employs others. The episode does name his hired guards (the Black Order, head of security Proxima Midnight), but he employs them; he doesn't serve in any group.

names.name: Polemachus
names.quote: Arkon: 'My name is Arkon, ruler of Polemachus. My planet is dying.' / 'People of Polemachus...'
names.why: X-Men: The Animated Series S5E7-8 'Storm Front' Parts 1-2 (series episodes 69-70). Arkon rules the planet and its people. This matches the dataset's use of realms such as Asgard and Sakaar as groups.

names.name: The Colon Crime Family
names.quote: News: 'rising tension between black and Latino street gangs' / Shades: 'my guess is that's Domingo and them' / Zip: 'Domingo Colon just declared war on us.'
names.why: Luke Cage S1E3/E12. Domingo leads a Latino gang ('his men'), but no name is given and 'Colon Crime Family' is never said. Options: (a) a descriptive label such as "Domingo's crew", following 'Kid Loki's Crew'; (b) none.

names.name: The Monster Hunting Cabal
names.quote: All: 'For stone and creed, for those who forged our blade. To rid this land of its abominations. There is no peace without blood, and so it shall be.' / Ulysses: 'choose a new leader in the crusade against monsters.'
names.why: Same group and decision as 'Monster Hunting Cabal' (Verussa). The two spellings should be merged into one. 'Cabal' is from marketing copy and is not said on screen. Options: none, or a label from the screen ('Crusade Against Monsters').

names.name: Russian Armed Forces
names.quote: (no line found) The only military reference is Natasha asking about 'General Solohob' (in Russian): 'I thought General Solohob is in charge of export.' Luchkov: 'Solohob is a courier. He's a front.' (from the MCU wiki's quotes)
names.why: The Avengers (2012). Luchkov wears a uniform with medals, but no line names the Russian Armed Forces or gives his rank. The wiki gets 'Colonel General' from his insignia. That is inferring a group from costume. On screen he is an arms dealer with henchmen. (I could not get captions for the 2012 film; the scene's lines are from the MCU wiki.)

names.name: Latveria
names.quote: (no line found) The film's captions never say 'Latveria', 'Doom' or 'Victor'. The mid-credits scene has only Sue: 'H.E.R.B.I.E., have you seen the book that Franklin loves?'
names.why: The Fantastic Four: First Steps. The cloaked figure is never named, and no country is named or shown.

names.name: The Kirov Gang
names.quote: Kraven: 'You are Semyon Chorny, leader of the Kirov gang. Your weapons are killing men, women and children all over the world.'
names.why: Kraven the Hunter, prison scene. Said on screen, and Chorney leads the gang. (The captions found look like a re-translation, so exact wording may differ slightly.)

names.name: Norse Paganists
names.quote: 'Jakob Nystrom, 30. Girlfriend, Petra Larsen. Leaders of a Norse Paganist hate group.' / 'Norse Paganist? Obsessed with anything derived from Norse mythology.'
names.why: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1E8 'The Well'. The group has no proper name; the screen calls it 'a Norse Paganist hate group', and 'Norse Paganists' is the plain equivalent. Key the stage to 'Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1'. The owner might prefer the longer 'Norse Paganist hate group'.

names.name: Booskans
names.quote: 'Die Booskan scum!' / King Yakan: 'Habooska's hordes took control of its power.'
names.why: Thor: Love and Thunder, opening battle. 'Booskan' is said, and Habooska leads the Booskan army.
